East River, New York No. II

description: Dark buildings loom in the foreground of this cityscape. These buildings are silhouetted against an illuminated river, which shines in tones of white, yellow, and pale blue. In the background, the opposite bank features hazy, abstracted buildings and smokestacks.
title: East River
